assumptions.price_rule: lowest listed CSV price per station among rows with a resolved location
assumptions.optimality: lowest cost within the planning model (49-gal planning tank, 1-mi margin per stop end, straight-line detours, candidates ≤ 5 mi) for exact amounts; purchases rounded to whole gallons (at most 1 extra gallon per stop)

notes: Detours are the extra miles to leave the route, reach the station and come back, estimated as twice the straight-line distance (not measured on roads), so a real leg can be slightly longer than planned; keep a reserve.
The plan keeps 4.0 extra miles of fuel as a safety margin for unverified detours; these miles are not driven.
Start tank (50.0 gal) is not charged; 5.4 gal left at finish.
Prices are the provided CSV snapshot, not live.
Each line cost is rounded to the cent and the total is rounded once, so they can differ by a few cents.
Fuel on arrival is rounded down and fuel burned to the nearest 0.1, so start + bought − burned can differ from the finish figure by 0.1 gal.
Fill stops buy whole gallons rounded down (the brim takes under 1 gallon more); other stops buy just enough, rounded up.
